papers.title_en: PULSE: Unlocking Practical Image Compression on Single-Thread CPU
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Jia, Tianyu Zhang, Zihan Zheng, Wenxuan Xie, Jiahao Li, Bin Li, Houqiang Li, Yan Lu
papers.evidence: 超低复杂度编解码器，整数线性CDF熵编码与元先验
papers.tldr: 现有学习图像压缩在CPU等资源受限硬件上计算开销高、难以实用。PULSE采用仅5.2 kMAC/像素的超低复杂度神经接收器，配合整数线性CDF预测器与元先验，实现高效且位精确的熵编码。为弥补压缩损失，它引入启发式探针引导的智能体进化，通过人机LLM协作迭代改进架构。最终单线程CPU解码1080p仅126ms，压缩性能可比HM，感知优化后能对标MS-ILLM。
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in learned image compression, existing methods remain computationally expensive on resource-constrained hardware, particularly CPUs. We introduce PULSE, a practical codec that enables (1) low-latency decoding on diverse hardware platforms with an ultra-low-complexity 5.2 kMAC/pixel neural receiver, and (2) efficient bit-exact entropy coding with an integer linear CDF predictor and a meta prior. To recover compression performance under this tight budget, we introduce an agentic evolution process guided by heuristic probes that iteratively improves the architecture through human-LLM collaboration. PULSE decodes a 1080p image in 126 ms on a single CPU thread while achieving compression performance comparable to HM. After perceptual optimization, PULSE competes with larger perceptual codecs like MS-ILLM. Codes are at https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/PULSE

papers.title_en: Successive Refinement Under Strong-Sense Perfect Perception
papers.authors: Yu Yang, Changhong Liu, Weijie Yuan, Lin Zhou
papers.evidence: 强意义完美感知约束下的率失真感知区域
papers.tldr: 本文重新审视多终端有损信源编码中的逐次细化问题：同一信源序列经压缩后，两个解码器需在不同失真水平下重建。作者在无限公共随机性下引入强意义完美感知约束，刻画相应的率-失真-感知区域。方法上，可达性证明借鉴输出约束有损信源编码，逆定理则改造经典逐次细化证明步骤。结果给出 Bernoulli 信源数值例，并证明其在 Hamming 失真下即使满足强完美感知约束仍可逐次细化，从而细化既有结论并揭示感知质量对分层压缩的影响。
papers.abstract_en: We revisit a multiterminal lossy source coding problem named successive refinement and derive the rate-distortion-perception region under the strong-sense perfect perception constraint in the presence of unlimited common randomness. Specifically, in successive refinement, one aims to compress a source sequence and allows two distinct decoders to recover the source sequence at different distortion levels. By imposing the strong-sense perfect perception constraint, our results refine the previous result by analyzing the impact of the perceptual quality. Our achievability proof is inspired by output constrained lossy source coding and our converse proof adapts the proof steps of the standard successive refinement problem. Furthermore, we provide a numerical example of the Bernoulli source to illustrate our result and show that the Bernoulli source under Hamming distortion is successively refinable even with the strong-sense perfect perception constraint.
